column1: # written verbatim from the inline reply (runner 9, H235, one Opus vision call, 29 Sept 2026)
# GROUP A: A 4- or Z-shaped hooked head joined to two parallel slanted down-strokes, giving a double-stemmed sign.
# GROUP B: A plain 4 with a separate 3- or z-shaped tail hanging at the lower right.
# GROUP C: A 4-shaped head on a tall stem that is crossed below the head by two horizontal bars, like a 4 sitting on a ≠ or #.
